_comment: Routes are tried in order. Status checked 2026-10-11: allbirds.com serves a live UCP profile (MCP transport); etsy/wayfair/target/walmart return 404 for public /.well-known/ucp, so they fall through to universal checkout. Any domain not listed here is auto-discovered (UCP first, so every Shopify store works).

merchants.name: Allbirds
merchants.notes: Shopify store. Live UCP over MCP; pays via Shop Pay / Google Pay / Shopify card handler, so completion hands off to the buyer unless a Stripe handler is offered.

merchants.name: Etsy
merchants.notes: UCP co-developer; UCP checkout is live inside Google AI Mode/Gemini but no public agent endpoint yet.

merchants.name: Wayfair
merchants.notes: UCP co-developer; live in Google surfaces, no public discovery yet.

merchants.name: Target
merchants.notes: UCP co-developer, rollout announced. Until public discovery appears, routed via universal checkout.

merchants.name: Walmart
merchants.notes: UCP co-developer; also an ACP partner inside ChatGPT. No public agent endpoint yet.

merchants.name: Amazon
merchants.notes: No agent checkout API, and Amazon's terms prohibit unauthorized automated agents, so computer-use is disabled here. Rye only (check Rye's current Amazon support).

merchants.name: Best Buy
merchants.notes: Public Products API is read-only; purchases go through universal checkout.

merchants.name: eBay
merchants.notes: eBay Buy APIs (Order API) require partner approval; add an adapter once approved.
